title: Bi: de Haas-van Alphen frequencies (pyskeaf)
summary: Rhombohedral bismuth: PAO Hamiltonian on the internal projections, Fermi surface on a 32^3 grid and the extremal-orbit (de Haas-van Alphen) frequencies and cyclotron masses with pyskeaf, for a field rotated from the trigonal to a binary axis. The Fermi surface of that run comes with the case, so the pyskeaf step also runs without QE.

qe.label: Self-consistent run (18x18x18 k grid, read by PAOFLOW)

steps.label: PAO Hamiltonian, Fermi surface and pyskeaf
steps.note: needs Bi2.save; generates BASIS_PS, writes output/Fermi_surf_band_*.bxsf, qo_EF_0_freqvsangle_*.out and plot_frequencies.png

steps.label: pyskeaf on the shipped Fermi surface (no QE run needed)
steps.note: about 40 s on 4 ranks; results in bxsf/ (python main_skeaf.py alone reruns pyskeaf on output/)
